b2-boliviaoriente-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Missions Were Founded by Jesuits
b2-boliviaoriente-01.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about the Chiquitos missions, and she asks who founded them.
b2-boliviaoriente-01.prompt: Tell Meg who founded the missions and when the first one was founded.
cues: Say the year of the first one
b2-boliviaoriente-01.target: Las misiones fueron fundadas por jesuitas, y la primera fue fundada en 1691.
b2-boliviaoriente-01.english: The missions were founded by Jesuits, and the first one was founded in 1691.
b2-boliviaoriente-01.canDo: I can say what was founded, expelled and restored with *ser* + past participle.

b2-boliviaoriente-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Big City, but a Small Past
b2-boliviaoriente-02.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading an article about Santa Cruz, and he asks if it was always a big city.
b2-boliviaoriente-02.prompt: Tell Carlos that it is large today but was small before.
cues: Say that it is the largest city
b2-boliviaoriente-02.target: Santa Cruz es hoy la ciudad más poblada de Bolivia; sin embargo, durante siglos fue una población pequeña.
b2-boliviaoriente-02.english: Santa Cruz is today the most populous city in Bolivia; however, for centuries it was a small town.
b2-boliviaoriente-02.canDo: I can contrast two ideas about Santa Cruz with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque*.

b2-boliviaoriente-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Apparently, Still Without Approval
b2-boliviaoriente-03.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a talk about lithium, and she asks about the contracts of 2024.
b2-boliviaoriente-03.prompt: Tell Meg, with a hedge, what the situation of the contracts is in 2026.
cues: Say that Congress has not approved them
b2-boliviaoriente-03.target: Según parece, los contratos de 2024 todavía no tienen la aprobación del Congreso.
b2-boliviaoriente-03.english: Apparently, the contracts of 2024 still do not have the approval of Congress.
b2-boliviaoriente-03.canDo: I can soften a claim about lithium with *parece que*, *según parece* and *podría decirse que*.

b2-boliviaoriente-04.title: Communicative Challenge: If They Had Had More Water
b2-boliviaoriente-04.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are visiting a museum exhibition about the Chaco War, and he asks what made the war so hard.
b2-boliviaoriente-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what would have helped the soldiers.
cues: Start with a condition about the past
Say that they would have suffered less
b2-boliviaoriente-04.target: Si los soldados hubieran tenido más agua, habrían sufrido menos.
b2-boliviaoriente-04.english: If the soldiers had had more water, they would have suffered less.
b2-boliviaoriente-04.canDo: I can talk about a past that did not happen with *si* + *hubiera* + participle and *habría* + participle.

b2-boliviaoriente-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dancers Who Wear Masks
b2-boliviaoriente-05.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a video of the Oruro carnival, and she asks who the dancers in masks are.
b2-boliviaoriente-05.prompt: Tell Meg who the dancers with masks are playing.
b2-boliviaoriente-05.target: Los bailarines que llevan máscaras de diablos participan en la diablada.
b2-boliviaoriente-05.english: The dancers who wear devil masks take part in the diablada.
b2-boliviaoriente-05.canDo: I can describe the dances and the people of the Oruro carnival with *que*, *quien* and *donde*.

b2-boliviaoriente-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Lowlands in Review
b2-boliviaoriente-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are preparing a short talk about the Bolivian lowlands, and he asks when the missions were declared World Heritage Sites.
b2-boliviaoriente-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos when UNESCO declared the missions a World Heritage Site.
b2-boliviaoriente-consolidation.target: Las seis misiones fueron declaradas Patrimonio de la Humanidad en 1990.
b2-boliviaoriente-consolidation.english: The six missions were declared World Heritage Sites in 1990.
b2-boliviaoriente-consolidation.canDo: I can review what I learned about the Chiquitos missions, Santa Cruz, Uyuni, the Chaco War and the Oruro carnival.
